--- a/export/export.go
+++ b/export/export.go
@@ -1,7 +1,20 @@
 package export
 
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"io"
+)
+
 // Record is one row of the usage export.
 type Record struct {
 	Name  string
 	Count int
 }
+
+// WriteCSV writes one name,count line per record and returns the first write error.
+func WriteCSV(w io.Writer, records []Record) error {
+	for _, r := range records {
+		fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s,%d\n", r.Name, r.Count)
+	}
+	return nil
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+package export
+
+import (
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+func TestWriteCSV(t *testing.T) {
+	var b strings.Builder
+	if err := WriteCSV(&b, []Record{{"a", 1}}); err != nil || b.String() != "a,1\n" {
+		t.Fatalf("WriteCSV = %q, %v", b.String(), err)
+	}
+}

Selected.explanation: WriteCSV discards the error from fmt.Fprintf and always returns nil, so a failed export is reported as success, contrary to its doc comment.
Selected.action: Return the first error from fmt.Fprintf.
